title: Lighter Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant chicken and rice layered with warm spices, peas, herbs and cooling yogurt.
ingredients: 1 tsp garam masala and 1/2 tsp turmeric
Garlic, ginger and chilli to taste
Mint, coriander and lemon to finish
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yogurt, spices, garlic and ginger.
Brown the chicken, add rinsed rice and enough water to cook gently under a lid.
Fold through peas and herbs, then serve with the remaining yogurt and lemon.

source.label: Adapted from Good Food chicken biryani

notes: Batch-cook this one — it reheats well and the flavor actually improves the next day.
